title: Allowance
summary: Spend-limited AI-agent account template with per-payment caps, per-epoch budgets and payment counts, approved payees, owner-reviewed requests and a panic freeze. The MIT repository includes Rust template source, an Esmeralda status page and a Python MCP server. The November 12 README describes a testnet deployment and creator-run tests using a freely mintable demo token with no value. Budgets reset by network epoch, not wall-clock hour; protecting the agent key remains necessary. The recording shows the README and its Esmeralda scope. No wallet, MCP server or third-party code was installed or run for this listing.
cardSummary: Set payment caps, epoch budgets and approved payees for AI agents, with owner-reviewed requests and a panic freeze.
